cutoff_window.rule: only sources published or visibly updated within the last 7 days; exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, or boundary-only dates

excluded_candidates.reason: Submitted before the 2026-06-24T21:00:55-04:00 cutoff, despite being search-visible as last week.
Exact published and modified dates are outside the 7-day window.

federation_routing.rule: Broad ecosystem entity updates route to upstream AI wiki; this artifact records only downstream local practice implications.

follow_up_notes: Ingest qualifying updates through the normal raw-source workflow before editing docs/wiki.
Keep this watcher raw-only; do not move this artifact to raw/processed until synthesis is complete.
Use selected leaf ids as the durable local page targets if a later ingest pass accepts the updates.
